text:
This Royal Oak is made of a metal that acts like glass.

Look at the shiny parts. The polished bezel and middle links of Audemars Piguet's Royal Oak Jumbo in titanium are bulk metallic glass, a palladium alloy cooled so fast its atoms freeze in a jumble, like glass, instead of lining up in neat rows. Everything else is brushed titanium.

Then AP added the colour: a smoked burgundy dial, bright red in the centre and almost black at the edge.

AP first tried this mix of metals on a one-off Royal Oak for the 2021 Only Watch charity auction, then released it in 2023. It is 39 mm wide and 8.1 mm thick. Price on request.
